newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares soar to new heights, correction seen.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares soar to new heights, correction seen.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher again on Thursday with the top-20 KFX index hitting a new record closing high for the eighth consecutive trading day, with the outlook quiet and stable with possible correction.
"Depending on how the Dow fares tonight, we should see a quiet market tomorrow with possible falls. Moeller DSSCb.CO and banks fuelled today's gains," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 2.81 point higher at 183.29 in overall bourse turnover of 1.406 billion crowns. The KFX August future rose 0.85 point to 182.55 with 310 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Moeller's D/S 1912 and D/S Svendborg put on 10,000 and 10,925 crowns respectively to close at 265,000 and 380,000 crowns.
Among top banks, Den Danske Bank rose 17 crowns to finish at 742, Unidanmark went up by an impressive 27 crowns to 429, while third biggest BG Bank ended eight crowns higher at 390.
